desc:
Welcome to Work at a Hotel & Resort RP — your dream destination for luxury, leisure, and roleplay! 🛎️🌆
With our city & restaurant hotel, this is the popular place to live, work, and unwind.

🏨 Check in guests, carry luggage, and serve at the front desk!
🛌 Explore and upgrade to luxurious penthouse apartments.
☕Serve the karens food at the restaurant, drive thru & deliver Uber!
🧑‍💼 Get promoted to become a barista, receptionist — or even the Hotel Manager!
💼 Rise through the ranks, lead your team, and build your job in luxury service.
✨ Earn coins to unlock effects, tools, and stylish nametags as you work!

👍 Like & Fav this game to unlock Budget Update at 10K Likes!

New Update:
🌇 New Lobby, Jobs & Designs!

How to Get a Job:
⭐ Walk behind the front desk and click yes!
💯 For promotions, join our group!
📋 Work hard for promotions by managers
